name: golden-voice
summary: Clone your voice locally with XTTS v2 and hear your terminal speak it — resident daemon, live pause/ff/2x/stop, fx, export. Free forever, no API keys, 100% local.
inputs: text (arg, stdin, clipboard, or last assistant turn)
outputs: spoken audio in your local XTTS voice clone (or macOS `say`)
exported library clips (wav + opus + mp3, -16 LUFS) + manifest.json
